task.description: Produce a fix design artefact for WF-03 Step 2. Category E (test code error). Root cause: navigateSpa in web/tests/e2e/pipeline.ts (lines ~171-179) uses history.pushState + synthetic popstate which races with React Router v6.4 createBrowserRouter reconciliation, causing AppShell/nav never to mount and execution context destruction. Design: rewrite navigateSpa to use page.goto (proven pattern in web/tests/e2e/tenants.e2e.spec.ts:74-79). loginWithToken's addInitScript already re-runs on every page.goto so authenticated state is preserved. Write the design to src/design/onboarding-e2e-nav-fix.md per backend_developer_guide §6 (Type E prose). Cover: function signature change, behavior, why page.goto is correct, backward compatibility for existing navigateSpa callers, and acceptance criteria. NO implementation code.
acceptance_criteria: Lists all callers of navigateSpa and confirms compatibility

result.summary: Type E prose design for ISS-0069 (Category E: test-harness SPA nav race). Single-file rewrite spec for navigateSpa in web/tests/e2e/pipeline.ts: replace history.pushState + synthetic popstate with page.goto + page.waitForURL (proven pattern from tenants.e2e.spec.ts:74-79). Auth preserved via addInitScript re-run on every goto. Audited 50+ call sites across 8 importing files; signature unchanged so all callers remain backward compatible. 6 local-shadow copies in other spec files left out of scope. Linter PASS. No implementation code.
